description: This source file implements a video screencast encoder using libvpx for VP8 encoding, with classes and functions for frame conversion, encoding, and file writing, specifically for Firefox's screencast feature.

classes.name: ScreencastEncoder::VPXFrame
classes.description: Represents a video frame to be encoded, with conversion to vpx_image_t format and duration management.

classes.name: ScreencastEncoder::VPXCodec
classes.description: Handles VP8 encoding using libvpx, manages encoding thread, and writes encoded frames to WebM file.

classes.name: ScreencastEncoder
classes.description: Main encoder class that manages frame encoding, timing, and finalization for screencast video.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates and initializes a vpx_image_t with specified width and height, allocating aligned buffer.

methods.name: ScreencastEncoder::VPXFrame::convertToVpxImage
methods.description: Converts a WebRTC VideoFrameBuffer to a vpx_image_t, applying cropping and scaling as needed.

methods.name: ScreencastEncoder::create
methods.description: Factory method to initialize a ScreencastEncoder with specified video size and margin.

methods.name: ScreencastEncoder::encodeFrame
methods.description: Encodes a video frame asynchronously, managing timing and frame repetition.

methods.name: ScreencastEncoder::finish
methods.description: Finalizes encoding, flushes remaining frames, and executes callback.
